name: JellyFetch
description: Automatically scrapes, orchestrates cloud downloads, and injects them directly into your Jellyfin library. Fully automatic UI install — no manual web file setup required.
overview: A powerful plugin built for Indian users (with 1tamilmv integration) to seamlessly download and organize media.

versions.changelog: Patch release: Fixed Seedr connection stalling (MissingMethodException), fixed post-download page rendering (metadata race condition), fixed background download hijacking user session, fixed Stop button label. Added automatic web UI installation — plugin now auto-patches index.html on startup, no manual dist.tar.gz required.
